trigger: The first fresh-seed follow-up was inconclusive at +4 pp but had unadjusted secondary Wilson intervals excluding nominal coverage at 0 and 10 pp.
monte_carlo_interval: Wilson interval for repeated-simulation target interval coverage
multiplicity: Bonferroni: 99% two-sided Wilson interval at each of five effect sizes; simultaneous familywise coverage is at least 95%.
estimator: Unchanged household difference-in-means with two-sided Welch 95% target intervals.
dgp: Unchanged Bernoulli household return DGP from backend/app/analysis/workbench.py.

decision_rule.any_simultaneous_interval_excludes_0.95: Evidence of an off-nominal coverage point in this specified synthetic DGP; preserve the estimator and plan a separate method study before changing it.
decision_rule.all_simultaneous_intervals_include_0.95: No familywise signal detected; this is not proof of calibration.

prohibited_changes: Do not reuse baseline or first-follow-up seeds.
Do not alter the household DGP, sample size, effect grid, Welch estimator, or target interval after inspecting results.
Do not select a correction or estimator based on this follow-up and then report the same run as validation.
